name: SQL 实战瓶颈诊断(综合案例)
description: SQL 性能瓶颈诊断是 DBA 最核心的实战技能。真实业务中的慢 SQL 往往不是单一原因，而是索引缺失、JOIN 顺序不当、临时表溢出、排序缓冲不足等多因素叠加。本规则提供系统化的诊断流程：从 EXPLAIN 分析入手，逐步定位瓶颈点，结合 performance_schema 和 sys schema 的诊断数据做出决策。关键原则：先看执行计划再改 SQL，先改 SQL 再加索引，先加索引再改架构。

signals.desc: 慢查询日志中出现高频或高耗时 SQL
QPS 突降或 SQL 执行时间突增
活跃线程数持续升高，说明 SQL 执行变慢

conditions.desc: TOP SQL 平均执行时间 > 1 秒
活跃线程数 > 20（与 CPU 核数相关）

skip_when.desc: 实例处于维护窗口（DDL、备份等），慢 SQL 预期中
慢查询仅出现 1 次且为手工查询

root_causes.name: 索引缺失或失效
root_causes.desc: 最常见的根因。WHERE/JOIN/ORDER BY 涉及的列缺少合适索引，或索引因隐式转换、函数调用、最左前缀不匹配而失效。EXPLAIN type=ALL 或 rows 远大于实际需要是典型信号。

root_causes.name: JOIN 顺序或方式不当
root_causes.desc: 多表 JOIN 时驱动表选错、缺少连接条件索引、笛卡尔积（漏写 ON 条件）等。当 EXPLAIN 显示某步 rows 爆炸式增长时，往往是 JOIN 问题。

root_causes.name: 排序/分组导致临时表溢出磁盘
root_causes.desc: ORDER BY / GROUP BY / DISTINCT / UNION 操作需要排序或分组，当数据量超过 sort_buffer_size 或 tmp_table_size 时溢出到磁盘临时表，性能急剧下降。EXPLAIN Extra 中 Using filesort / Using temporary 是典型信号。

root_causes.name: 查询返回数据量过大
root_causes.desc: SELECT * 返回所有列、缺少 LIMIT、不必要的大范围扫描。查询本身不慢但传输大量数据消耗网络和客户端内存。rows_sent 远大于业务需要是典型信号。

step1_top_slow_sql.desc: 找出消耗资源最多的 TOP 10 SQL
step1_top_slow_sql.sql: SELECT DIGEST_TEXT, COUNT_STAR AS exec_count, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 2) AS total_sec, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 3) AS avg_sec, SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED AS rows_examined, SUM_ROWS_SENT AS rows_sent, ROUND(SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED / GREATEST(SUM_ROWS_SENT, 1), 0) AS exam_sent_ratio, SUM_NO_INDEX_USED AS full_scans, SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES AS disk_tmp FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 10

step2_current_running.desc: 查看当前正在执行的慢 SQL
step2_current_running.sql: SELECT id, user, db, time, state, ROUND(trx.trx_rows_locked, 0) AS rows_locked, SUBSTRING(info, 1, 300) AS query FROM information_schema.processlist p LEFT JOIN information_schema.innodb_trx trx ON p.id = trx.trx_mysql_thread_id WHERE command = 'Query' AND time > 2 ORDER BY time DESC

step3_explain_target.desc: 对目标 SQL 执行 EXPLAIN
step3_explain_target.note: 重点关注 type (ALL/index/range/ref/eq_ref)、rows、filtered、Extra (Using filesort/Using temporary/Using where)

step4_filesort_tmp_stats.desc: 检查全局排序和临时表统计
step4_filesort_tmp_stats.sql: SELECT VARIABLE_NAME, VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME IN ('Sort_merge_passes', 'Sort_rows', 'Sort_scan', 'Created_tmp_tables', 'Created_tmp_disk_tables', 'Select_full_join', 'Select_scan')

step5_index_usage.desc: 查看未使用的索引（sys schema）
step5_index_usage.sql: SELECT object_schema, object_name, index_name FROM sys.schema_unused_indexes WHERE object_schema NOT IN ('mysql', 'performance_schema') ORDER BY object_schema, object_name
step5_index_usage.version_note: 需要 sys schema（5.7+ 内置）且 performance_schema 开启

step6_table_scan_tables.desc: 找出全表扫描最频繁的表
step6_table_scan_tables.sql: SELECT object_schema, object_name, count_read AS total_reads, count_fetch AS fetches, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_FETCH/1e12, 2) AS fetch_sec FROM performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_table WHERE count_fetch > 10000 ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_FETCH DESC LIMIT 10

step1_slow_query_impact.desc: 评估慢查询对系统的影响
step1_slow_query_impact.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS slow_count, MAX(ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 3)) AS max_avg_sec, SUM(COUNT_STAR) AS total_exec FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE AVG_TIMER_WAIT > 1e12 AND SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys')

step2_top_sql_digest.sql: SELECT SUBSTRING(DIGEST_TEXT, 1, 6) AS top_type, COUNT(*) AS type_count, SUM(COUNT_STAR) AS total_exec FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest WHERE AVG_TIMER_WAIT > 1e12 AND SCHEMA_NAME NOT IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys') GROUP BY top_type ORDER BY SUM(SUM_TIMER_WAIT) DESC LIMIT 1

step3_explain_top.desc: 分析TOP慢SQL的执行计划特征
step3_explain_top.sql: SELECT DIGEST_TEXT, SUM_NO_INDEX_USED AS no_index, SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES AS disk_tmp, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 3) AS avg_sec, SUM_ROWS_EXAMINED AS rows_examined, CASE WHEN SUM_NO_INDEX_USED > 0 THEN 'ALL' WHEN SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES > 0 THEN 'filesort' ELSE 'other' END AS type, CASE WHEN SUM_CREATED_TMP_DISK_TABLES > 0 THEN 'Using filesort' ELSE '' END AS extra FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 5

emergency_playbook.scenario: 大量慢 SQL 堆积导致实例几乎不可用

steps.action: 确认当前正在运行的慢 SQL
steps.sql: SELECT id, user, db, time, state, SUBSTRING(info, 1, 200) FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE command = 'Query' AND time > 5 ORDER BY time DESC

steps.action: kill 掉非核心业务的慢查询释放资源
steps.risk: kill 写入事务会触发回滚
steps.note: 优先 kill 读查询，慎重 kill 写事务

steps.action: 找出 TOP 慢 SQL 的 DIGEST
steps.sql: SELECT DIGEST, DIGEST_TEXT, COUNT_STAR, ROUND(AVG_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 3) AS avg_sec FROM performance_schema.events_statements_summary_by_digest ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 5

steps.action: 对 TOP 1 慢 SQL 执行 EXPLAIN 分析
紧急加索引或使用 hint 固定执行计划
steps.sql: ALTER TABLE {table} ADD INDEX idx_emergency ({col}), ALGORITHM=INPLACE, LOCK=NONE

version_specific_notes.5.7: EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON 已支持。无 EXPLAIN ANALYZE。Semi Join 优化可用。sys.statement_analysis 提供 SQL 分析视图。optimizer_trace 可追踪优化器决策过程
version_specific_notes.8.0: EXPLAIN ANALYZE 提供实际执行统计。Hash Join 替代 BNL 改善无索引 JOIN。直方图改善数据倾斜场景。optimizer hint 语法更丰富。CTE 和窗口函数提供新的 SQL 改写思路
version_specific_notes.8.4: EXPLAIN ANALYZE 输出迭代器模型更多细节。优化器成本模型改进。自适应 Hash Join 内存管理

real_world_examples.scenario: ORDER BY + LIMIT 翻页查询随页码增大急剧变慢
real_world_examples.symptoms: SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY id LIMIT 1000000, 20 耗时 15 秒。第 1 页 10ms，第 5 万页 15 秒
real_world_examples.root_cause: 深翻页问题：MySQL 需要扫描前 100 万行再丢弃，LIMIT offset 越大越慢
real_world_examples.resolution: 改写为延迟关联：SELECT o.* FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT id FROM orders ORDER BY id LIMIT 1000000, 20) t ON o.id = t.id
real_world_examples.result: 任意页码查询稳定在 50ms 内

real_world_examples.scenario: 5 表 JOIN 查询因驱动表选错导致 rows 爆炸
real_world_examples.symptoms: EXPLAIN 显示第 3 步 rows=500万，总扫描超过 1 亿行，查询超时
real_world_examples.root_cause: 优化器将大表作为驱动表，且 JOIN 条件列缺少索引
real_world_examples.resolution: 为 JOIN 条件列添加组合索引，并用 STRAIGHT_JOIN 固定小表驱动大表的顺序
